_help.searchBases: List of OU distinguished names to scan. Empty list = the whole domain.
_help.includeAccountExpiry: Monitor users whose AccountExpirationDate is set (accountExpires attribute).
_help.includePasswordExpiry: Monitor password expiry (msDS-UserPasswordExpiryTimeComputed) for users in passwordExpirySearchBases / passwordExpiryGroups. Meant for service accounts, not the whole user population.
_help.passwordExpirySearchBases: OU distinguished names whose users get password-expiry monitoring. Empty = none (unless passwordExpiryGroups is set).
_help.passwordExpiryGroups: AD group names whose direct user members get password-expiry monitoring.

description: Active Directory account '{{samAccountName}}' ({{distinguishedName}}) - {{expiryType}} expires on {{expireDate}}. Extend the account / rotate the password in AD and update every system that uses it (scheduled tasks, services, application pools, connection strings).

mail.mailBody: The Active Directory {{expiryType}} for '{{name}}' ({{samAccountName}}) expires on {{expireDate}}. Handle it before then.
